title: Padmé Amidala
description: Queen Amidala of Naboo got caught up in the machinations of the Trade Federation and Darth Sidious. Padmé met the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi and left the planet with them. While disguised as her own handmaiden, she met Anakin Skywalker. Forging an alliance with the Gungans, Padmé and her allies retook Naboo after battling the Droid Army.
